name: 重生的世界 (Revival World)
group_note: GPLv2 BIG5 life-sim, distinct lineage (RWlib v1.0.1, a large kernel-mudlib codebase with ~70 preloaded system daemons, completely unrelated to this project's wuxia/martial-arts libs). Previously classified 'noboot': a 2026-07-23 re-verification pass found system/kernel/simul_efun/ansi.lpc's ANSI-color handling calls pcre_replace_callback()/pcre_replace()/pcre_match_all() directly from the BOOT-CRITICAL simul_efun file itself, and the WASM build at that time shipped without the pcre package at all (documented in fluffos's own docs/build-wasm.md) -- fluffos_boot() failed outright with "No program in object '/system/kernel/simul_efun'!", not producing any transcript, a genuine driver-capability gap rather than a mudlib bug. Re-tested this session against the current WASM driver build and confirmed docs/build-wasm.md now documents PCRE support was added ("the pcre package is on, so its tests run for real") -- this lib now boots completely cleanly with no code changes needed. Confirmed via a full continuous session: boots through all ~70 preloaded systems (a handful of purely socket-dependent daemons -- dict_d, ftp_d, http_client_d, im_d, realnews_d, smtp_d, socket_d, socket_ob, translate_d, whois_d -- fail to compile and are skipped, exactly as tolerated elsewhere in this project, none of them boot-blocking); reaches the GB/BIG5 charset prompt and English-ID prompt; a full NEW player registration (id -> name -> password + confirm -> email -> gender) completes end-to-end and enters the starting room (巫師神殿) with a newbie-tip message; the pre-existing admin account (fluffos, seeded in an earlier WASM-enablement pass into system/kernel/data/secure.o's wizards mapping) logs in via the loopback-triggered wizard-login auto-redirect (enter the ID a second time when re-prompted, then the admin password) and reaches the wizard-only starting room (巫師大廳) with the '由<Admin/...>連線進入' system banner confirming admin rank; quit is clean from both flows ('你離開遊戲了'). This lib's earlier WASM-enablement pass (loopback-allow gates, throttle exemption, admin seeding into secure.o) is unchanged and still applies -- no further code changes were needed this pass, purely a status correction now that the upstream driver capability gap has closed.
